exposure: gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosed early in pregnancy
gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosed late in pregnancy
cohort: 1481 women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus in Japan
finding: Maternal complications, including hypertensive disorders of pregnancy and cesarean delivery, were higher in the early gestational diabetes mellitus diagnosis group than in the late diagnosis group.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were higher in the group diagnosed with gestational diabetes early in pregnancy (<24 weeks) compared to those diagnosed later in pregnancy.
